trust_decision.summary: Whether a config-supplied _target_ (and any callable it resolves to, selects or returns) may be invoked is decided by name in _authorize_target_name via _resolve_target; _call_target then invokes or wraps the target in a partial and returns the result with no further check.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'target blacklist bypasses'. The first place to look is _is_blocklisted_target and the DEFAULT_BLOCKLISTED_MODULES set at hydra/_internal/instantiate/_instantiate2.py:21-95.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about blocklist names. Mediating what a legitimate target returns, or what a _partial_ selects later, looks like a different feature (result handling and the deprecated functools.partial target), not the blocklist. hydra.utils.get_method is a documented public helper, not a dangerous target.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: An exact whitelist entry for a re-exported target (e.g. json.JSONDecoder resolving to json.decoder.JSONDecoder) must skip the resolved-identity recheck. _partial_: true must keep returning a usable partial. getattr with a non-callable result and get_class with a whitelisted path must keep working. Plugin instantiation passes a callable _target_ with an exact whitelist. Blocking every discovery helper or getattr, or always rechecking the resolved identity, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: string alias via another module's attribute (logging.os.system) resolved by _locate
functools.partial object wrapping a blocked callable
discovery helper target with path as positional _args_ or as path kwarg
callable returned by builtins.getattr or functools.partial target
prefix families (logging.config., doctest., pdb., ...) with exact exceptions

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Optuna sweeper resolves the config string hydra.sweeper.custom_search_space with hydra.utils.get_method and calls it with (config, trial). It never goes through instantiate's blocklist or whitelist, although its own sampler instantiate does pass a whitelist.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: A plugin option documented as a user callback dotpath (plugins/hydra_optuna_sweeper/hydra_plugins/hydra_optuna_sweeper/config.py:178-182), not instantiate. Fixed call signature (DictConfig, Trial) limits what a blocked callable can do.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate plugin package (plugins/hydra_optuna_sweeper), 2 packages away from hydra/_internal/instantiate

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Resolve hydra.callbacks entries with _locate/get_class plus a direct constructor call instead of instantiate(params).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Callbacks are a fixed shape (_target_ plus kwargs), so a maintainer could plausibly bypass instantiate for speed or to avoid deprecation warnings.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A get_method-style helper (e.g. get_callable with args) used by a plugin to resolve a config dotpath.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The pattern already exists in the optuna sweeper (plugins/hydra_optuna_sweeper/hydra_plugins/hydra_optuna_sweeper/_impl.py:147). Other launchers (joblib/submitit/ray) take similar callback options.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ConvertMode.OBJECT path constructing an object type taken from override metadata.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: object_type can come from an override DictConfig (hydra/_internal/instantiate/_instantiate2.py:1228-1231). A maintainer extending structured-config conversion could let a config-named type reach construction without _resolve_target.

O9_family: Incomplete denylist (CWE-184) on config-driven callable instantiation, leading to code execution

Fairness concern: the published fix is largely an enumerated stdlib denylist (~100 names, fix.diff:1727-1932). Hidden tests parametrised over those names would not be derivable from a short report in 45 minutes, so O11 is 90 and test selection must favour mechanism (partial/getattr/discovery result mediation, whitelist non-authorisability) over list membership.
Whether the optuna custom_search_space route can reach a harmful callable given the fixed (DictConfig, Trial) call signature is not established; it is recorded as a route by property only.
